ghiChu: T7 — (a) GHIM C1 trong CHROME THAT: `.ed__khung` PHAI la khung cuon that, va mot hang NGOAI cua so ban dau PHAI tro thanh CO MAT trong DOM sau khi cuon; (b) do CAI GIA CO TRAN cua ban va D4 bang PHIM `n` THAT (gieo `suspect` o i=1 va i=481), kem KHANG DINH TIEN DE de luot sau DO thay vi lang le cho so vo nghia. steps.js: (() => { const thu = ['.shell', '.shell__mid', '.shell__work', '.ed', '.ed__khung']; const ra = {}; for (const t of thu) { const e = document.querySelector(t); if (e === null) { ra[t] = 'khong thay'; continue; } e.scrollTop = 5000; ra[t] = e.scrollTop; } window.scrollTo(0, 5000); ra.window_scrollY = window.scrollY; window.scrollTo(0, 0); return JSON.stringify(ra); })()
